cmd: whoami && cat /etc/os-release | head -3 && which git nginx sshd ssh-keygen openssl python3 2>&1

set -e
# 1. Create git user with password
id git 2>/dev/null || useradd -m -s /bin/bash git
echo 'git:password' | chpasswd
# 2. Repo
mkdir -p /git
git init --bare /git/project
chown -R git:git /git
# 3. SSH config: allow password auth
mkdir -p /run/sshd
grep -q '^PasswordAuthentication' /etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo 'PasswordAuthentication yes' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sed -i 's/^#*PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sed -i 's/^#*PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
/usr/sbin/sshd -t && echo SSHD_CONFIG_OK

set -e
id git 2>/dev/null || useradd -m -s /bin/bash git
echo 'git:password' | chpasswd
mkdir -p /git
git init --bare /git/project
chown -R git:git /git
echo DONE_USER_REPO

sed -i 's/^#PasswordAuthentication yes/PasswordAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; grep -c '^PasswordAuthentication yes' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; ls /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf 2>/dev/null
